main_text.p: vae,[?] Eccl.9.9. Plur. הֶבֶל הַבָּלִים[?] Vanitas vanitatum, Eccl.1. v.2. Constr. הַבְלִי שָׁוְא[?] Vanitates, res nihili, Psalm.31.7. Aff. בְּהַבְלֵיהֶם[?] Vanitatibus suis, Deut.32,21.

הבל Kal, Evanescere, Vanum fieri vel effici: Futur. וַיֶּהְבְּלוּ[?] Et vani effecti sunt, Jer. 2.5. תֶּהְבַּל[?] Evanescatis, Psal. 62.11. Hiph.Particip. מַהְבִּילִים הֵמָּה אֶתְכֶם[?] Vanos efficiunt ipsi vos, Jer.23.16.
הבן הַבְּנִים[?] m.p. Ebena ligna, juxta Kimchium, Ezech.27. v.15. Virgil. Sola India nigrum fert Ebenum.

הבר Observare, Contemplari: Particip. הֹבֵרֵי שָׁמַיִם[?] Observatores caelorum, Jesa.47.13. חַכְמֵי הַמַּזָּלוֹת[?] Peritos signorum calestium, i.e. Astrologos, exponit. Vox peregrina videtur, unde Kimchi ex Arabico deduxit.

הגר Meditari: Et a mente ad os translatum; Effari, Eloqui: Musitare: Gemere, de Columbis: Rugire, de Leonibus: Item Auferre, Removere: Praeter. הֵגָה בְרוּחוֹ[?] Aufert vento suo, Jesa.27.8. Infinit. הָגוֹ סִיגִים[?] Auferre scorias, Prov.25.4.5. הָרוֹ וְהָגוֹ מִלֵּב[?] Concipere & effari ex animo verba falsa, Jesa.59.13. cum Cholem ab initio loco Kametz. Futur. אֶהְגֶּה כְּיוֹנָה[?] Gemebam ut columba, Jesa.38.14. כַּאֲשֶׁר יֶהְגֶּה הָאַרְיֵה[?] Sicut rugit leo, Jesa.31.4. Pyh. Praeterit. הָגָה[?] Amotus fuit, 2.Sam.20.13. pro הָנָה[?]. Hiphil.Participic.Plur. הַמֵּהְגִּים[?] Qui musitant, Jes.8.19.
הגר הָגּוּ[?] m. Sermo, Loquela, Gemitus, Job.37.2. Ezech.2. vers.10.
הגי הָגִּי[?] m. Meditatio: Aff. הָגִיגִי[?] Meditationem meam, Psal.5.2. per geminationem secundae radicalis.
הגיון הָגִּיּוֹן[?] m. Idem, Psal.9.17. Constr. וְהָגְיוֹן לִבִּי[?] Et meditatio cordis mei, Psal.19.15.
הגות הָגוּת[?] f. Idem: וְהָגוּת לִבִּי[?] Et meditatio cordis mei, Psal.94.4.

page.notes: Hebrew is transcribed from a low-resolution scan; vowel points and some letters are uncertain and marked [?]. The first line is a fragment ("vae," probably), marked [?]. The running head and the first Hebrew line are doubtful. Hanging Hebrew headwords in the left margin are recorded as notes at their entries. The Latin "verf" is read as "vers". The page number is read as 153.
